description: This file contains unit tests for the ReconnectActor class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging package. It verifies connection ID conversion and connection recovery behavior using Akka actors and testing tools.

classes.name: ReconnectActorTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the ReconnectActor class, testing connection recovery, ID conversion, and ensuring no duplicate recoveries.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem before tests run.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests are executed.

methods.name: conversionBetweenCorrelationIdAndConnectionIdIsOneToOne
methods.description: Verifies that converting between correlation IDs and connection IDs is a one-to-one mapping.

methods.name: testRecoverConnections
methods.description: Tests that the ReconnectActor correctly recovers connections from persistence.

methods.name: testRecoverConnectionsIsNotStartedTwice
methods.description: Ensures that the connection recovery process is not initiated multiple times concurrently.
